content: To minimize fetal risk, use a 9% sodium chloride (NaCl) solution with a rinse volume that is equal to or greater than the priming volume of any intravenous (IV) infusion set being used. If more than one infusion bag is provided, administer the contents of each bag completely before thawing and infusing the next bag. Additionally, if multiple infusion bags are required, do not administer more than one bag per hour.
